svg.title: One statement runs the tool call and writes its trace
svg.desc: When the agent calls a tool with Cypher and arguments, one Cypher statement runs the tool's Cypher in a CALL subquery that returns the answers and the touched nodes. The same statement collects them, creates a ToolCall with its HAS_CALL timestamp, and merges a TOUCHED relationship to each node, committing whole or not at all. The agent then reads the answers.

span.p: One Cypher statement: commits whole, or not at all
